soru: SMT tabanlı sınırlı model denetimi ile C/C++ yazılımının biçimsel doğrulanması ve bu alandaki araçların gelişimi üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: SMT tabanlı sınırlı model denetimi ile C/C++ yazılımının biçimsel doğrulanması ve bu alandaki araçların gelişimi üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-04-25. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: A Tool for Checking ANSI-C Programs
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced CBMC, the foundational bounded model checker for C, which nearly all later C/C++ BMC tools build on or compare against.

calismalar.baslik: Symbolic Model Checking without BDDs
calismalar.gerekce: Defined bounded model checking itself, the basis of all later SAT/SMT-based software BMC.

calismalar.baslik: SMT-Based Bounded Model Checking for Embedded ANSI-C Software
calismalar.gerekce: The key ESBMC paper: it showed that SMT background theories (bit-vectors, arrays, tuples) give efficient, precise BMC of real C software.

calismalar.baslik: Bounded model checking of software using SMT solvers instead of SAT solvers
calismalar.gerekce: An early systematic study of replacing SAT with SMT in software BMC.

calismalar.baslik: ESBMC 5.0: An Industrial-Strength C Model Checker
calismalar.gerekce: Describes the mature SMT-backend architecture and k-induction support that made ESBMC a strong industrial tool.

calismalar.baslik: LLBMC: Bounded Model Checking of C and C++ Programs Using a Compiler IR
calismalar.gerekce: Pioneered SMT-based BMC of C and C++ on LLVM IR with a precise memory model.

calismalar.baslik: Model checking C++ programs
calismalar.gerekce: A comprehensive SMT-based BMC approach for C++ features such as templates, exceptions, inheritance and the STL, using operational models.

calismalar.baslik: SMT-Based Bounded Model Checking of C++ Programs
calismalar.gerekce: The first extension of ESBMC to C++, addressing templates and the standard library.

calismalar.baslik: ESBMC v7.4: Harnessing the Power of Intervals
calismalar.gerekce: Recent tool evolution that combines interval analysis with SMT-based BMC and k-induction.

calismalar.baslik: CBMC – C Bounded Model Checker (Competition Contribution)
calismalar.gerekce: Documents CBMC's development and its performance on the SV-COMP benchmarks.

calismalar.baslik: Z3: An Efficient SMT Solver
calismalar.gerekce: The most widely used SMT solver backend in software BMC tools.

calismalar.baslik: Boolector: An Efficient SMT Solver for Bit-Vectors and Arrays
calismalar.gerekce: A bit-vector/array solver that often performs best in BMC of C programs.

calismalar.baslik: Bitwuzla
calismalar.gerekce: A state-of-the-art bit-vector and floating-point SMT solver adopted by modern BMC tools.

calismalar.baslik: Verifying multi-threaded software using SMT-based context-bounded model checking
calismalar.gerekce: Extended SMT-based BMC to concurrent C programs with context bounding.

calismalar.baslik: Partial Orders for Efficient Bounded Model Checking of Concurrent Software
calismalar.gerekce: A partial-order encoding for concurrent BMC that also handles weak memory models.

calismalar.baslik: Bounded Model Checking of Multi-threaded C Programs via Lazy Sequentialization
calismalar.gerekce: Lazy-CSeq: verifies concurrent C efficiently by reducing it to sequential BMC.

calismalar.baslik: Handling loops in bounded model checking of C programs via k-induction
calismalar.gerekce: Uses k-induction to address the open problem of unbounded loops, moving BMC toward full proofs.

calismalar.baslik: Software Verification Using k-Induction
calismalar.gerekce: A foundational work bringing k-induction to software verification.

calismalar.baslik: Boosting k-Induction with Continuously-Refined Invariants
calismalar.gerekce: Strengthens k-induction with invariant generation, addressing a central weakness.

calismalar.baslik: Code-level model checking in the software development workflow
calismalar.gerekce: Reports on industrial CBMC use at AWS and the practical challenges of fitting BMC into development workflows.

calismalar.baslik: Model Checking Boot Code from AWS Data Centers
calismalar.gerekce: A landmark case study applying BMC to low-level industrial C code.

calismalar.baslik: Behavioral consistency of C and Verilog programs using bounded model checking
calismalar.gerekce: One of the first works applying BMC to C programs.

calismalar.baslik: F-Soft: Software Verification Platform
calismalar.gerekce: An early industrial platform that combined BMC with abstraction for C programs.

calismalar.baslik: CPAchecker: A Tool for Configurable Software Verification
calismalar.gerekce: A leading framework that integrates BMC with other analyses and is a main comparison point.

calismalar.baslik: State of the Art in Software Verification and Witness Validation: SV-COMP 2024
calismalar.gerekce: The reference competition report that tracks the evolution and relative performance of BMC tools.

calismalar.baslik: ESBMC 6.1: automated test case generation using bounded model checking
calismalar.gerekce: Extends BMC to automated test generation.

calismalar.baslik: FuSeBMC: A White-Box Fuzzer for Finding Security Vulnerabilities in C Programs
calismalar.gerekce: A hybrid of BMC and fuzzing that tackles BMC's scalability problem.

calismalar.baslik: Towards counterexample-guided k-induction for fast bug detection
calismalar.gerekce: Speeds up bug detection with counterexample-guided k-induction.

calismalar.baslik: The FormAI Dataset: Generative AI in Software Security through the Lens of Vulnerability Classification
calismalar.gerekce: A large dataset that uses ESBMC to label vulnerabilities in LLM-generated C code.

calismalar.baslik: A New Era in Software Security: Towards Self-Healing Software via Large Language Models and Formal Verification
calismalar.gerekce: Combines BMC counterexamples with LLMs for automatic repair, opening a new research direction.
